purpose: map the full registered concurrency/context/failure-type mechanism region instead of selecting a favorable cell for S1, S4, or S8

required_phase1_mechanism_coverage: Full has nonzero Algorithm-1 slack inputs
Full executes exactly three Algorithm-3 control windows
At least one Full cell observes pressure and capacity rejection or eviction
noAlg1 has zero Algorithm-1 slack inputs
noAlg2 uses the declared Static-FCFS component-disabled adaptation
noAlg3 executes zero Algorithm-3 control windows
Both failure types have nonzero causally changed workflow observations
All fault replays are WCT-monotone and all empty replays reproduce healthy completion
phase2_expansion_gate.action_on_pass: run the entire matrix for the remaining two paired seeds
phase2_expansion_gate.action_on_fail: fail-close and report the uncovered mechanism region without selecting a substitute cell

estimands.primary: failure-conditioned WCT and added WCT among causally changed workflows, by full factorial cell
estimands.healthy: DES WCT including each policy's modeled own-transfer normal-path burden
estimands.ablation: paired Full/ablation relative difference at every cell; no pooled superiority threshold
estimands.mechanism: slack, admission, eviction, occupancy, recovery hit, alpha, pressure, and copy queue counters

fidelity_notes.Native Mooncake: modeled Store-only approximation; 60 s replacement is modeled and unmeasured
fidelity_notes.AegisKV: worker failure uses modeled unmeasured 500 ms prebound fence activation; same-node source-node failure uses modeled unmeasured 60 s replacement
fidelity_notes.AegisKV no Algorithm 2: Static-FCFS two-tier component-disabled adaptation, not a surgical production Algorithm-2 deletion
fidelity_notes.bandwidth: main model remains A100 40 GiB with semantically separate copy and load tables; values are modeled, not physical A100 calibration

evidence_boundary: Preliminary metadata DES mechanism-region evidence. No result is paper-ready physical evidence, and preview figures must not replace the stable PDF figures without a later evidence review.
